description: July 23 birthday meaning: Cancer or Leo cusp, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, July 23 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Cancer or Leo. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: July 23 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Leo season opens on July 23rd in most years, with the Sun at the first degree of the Lion, although some birth years and times still read as late Cancer. The cusp combines sensitivity and warmth. Birthday number 5 adds a love of variety and adventure, so this date is often pictured as a generous spirit who craves fresh experience.

On July 23 the Sun usually sits at about 0° Leo, in the first decan, where Sun rules the decan as well as the sign. Around July 21 to July 23, the Sun moves from Cancer, a water sign, into Leo, a fire sign. Born near that line, your Sun sign hangs on the exact year, time and birthplace, because the crossing does not happen at the same moment each July. A chart cast for your details will settle which side you are on. Astrologers often say people on this cusp combine lunar sensitivity with solar warmth and confidence. That blend can look like a protective host: someone who wants to be seen, and wants everyone in the room to feel safe.

sections.heading: July 23 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 23rd, you have a compound of 2 + 3 = 5. The 2 brings sensitivity and the 3 brings expression, and the 5 that results is curious, social and quick on its feet. People born on the 23rd are often described as excellent communicators with a gift for reading people and a strong appetite for new experiences. Travel, languages and varied work tend to appeal. Among the day numbers, the 23 is traditionally seen as one of the most adaptable. Commitment can feel restrictive, so choosing carefully what to say yes to helps them keep their freedom meaningful.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 23 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on July 23: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 23 is the 204th day of the year (205th in a leap year). By August 23, 31 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Virgo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 23, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 23 include Sergio Mattarella (1941), Haile Selassie I (1892) and Daniel Radcliffe (1989).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 23?
faq.answer: July 23 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Cancer or Leo on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Leo. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 23?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 23 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 23rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 23?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 23 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 23?
faq.answer: July 23 is also the birthday of Sergio Mattarella (1941), Haile Selassie I (1892) and Daniel Radcliffe (1989). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
